provider_scope: NanoJev FP32 and the Laya typed-decisions checkpoint currently selected in the user's match; not a claim about all variants.
quality_gate: Evaluate separately by checkpoint on matched seeds/sides. Candidate may be called tested-best only if elimination wins do not decrease, losses/caps and own tank deaths do not increase, and mean ticks on pairs where both eliminate do not increase; require at least one strict quality or compute improvement. Report Pareto tradeoffs and insufficient samples, not global optimality. No automatic live promotion.
iteration_stop: One frozen candidate in this cycle. If the held-out gate fails, retain baseline and open a new bounded cycle with fresh holdouts; never retune on these inspected holdouts.
safety: No cloud, retries, silent provider swaps, weight training or interruption of the user's active match. Actual model matches require explicit consent and an idle gateway; screen is CPU-only and is not an isolated latency benchmark.
